deities.name: Sigrananna
deities.rationale: Lunar cycles are the organizing principle of Moonmolt bodies and civic life.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Hathruna
deities.rationale: Chosen molts and preserved seasonal skins enact visible cycles of shedding, return, and rebirth.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nefarokir
deities.rationale: Archived skins holding selected memories connect civic remembrance to Nefarokir.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
